card.name: Pointers to other drugs' prescribing information
card.fires_on: The word just before "prescribing information" or "package inserts" in cross-references, such as "respective", "approved", or the end of a drug name. It appears in sentences like "See the respective..." or "Refer to the X prescribing information".

modes.label: "respective" before labeling
modes.description: The word "respective" after "the" or "their", pointing to each drug's own label.

modes.label: Drug name before prescribing information
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name right before "prescribing information" in a referral.
modes.example: Refer to the oxalipl<<atin>> prescribing information for additional dosing information as

modes.label: Other modifier before labeling
modes.description: A modifier like "approved" before "product labeling" in a consult instruction.
modes.example: Consult the<< approved>> product labeling for lamotrigine.
